topic_title: Move Over / Slow Down Act — Passing Stopped Service Vehicles
prompt: Which stationary vehicle type is protected under the expanded Texas Move Over/Slow Down Act?

options.text: Privately owned passenger cars parked on residential street driveways
Commercial tractor-trailers parked at designated highway rest areas
Public transit buses operating on scheduled passenger bus transit stops
Police, EMS, fire, tow trucks, TxDOT vehicles, and utility work vehicles

svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 180" class="w-full max-h-48 rounded-xl bg-[#1C201D]">
